what: S7 (1.98.0) hand fixes: (1) workers cannot npm install, so @supabase/ssr was missing and 3 tickets stayed in review (accept-failed-check typecheck); (2) design tickets are skipped by go --scope and ready->done is illegal, needed running->review->done by hand; (3) a ticket with deletes still gets the prompt 'Do not delete files' so the worker refused until the acceptance said it may; (4) typecheck run against stale .next/types failed the sync; (5) log-lint test failed on a timestamp .555Z matching /555/ (fixed by freezing the clock).
rule: Document dependencies a ticket needs in the ticket and let a package.json ticket own them; design tickets should be buildable or closable by command; the deletes prompt must say the listed files may be deleted; typecheck for sync should ignore .next.
fix: Installed deps by hand, closed T-0101 by hand, reworded T-0167 acceptance, deleted stale .next/types, froze the clock in log-lint.
